premises.text: Traptic's robots automate the strawberry harvesting process
premises.evidence_span: Traptic's giant farming robots pick strawberries.

premises.text: The robotic platform can detect and reach berries using a vision system
premises.evidence_span: our vision system detects the berries and figures out how to reach them.

premises.text: The patented gripper can delicately extract produce from plants
premises.evidence_span: our patented gripper delicately extracts the produce from the plant.

premises.text: The system operates robustly in various environmental conditions
premises.evidence_span: It is robust to dust, dirt, rain, wind, vibrations, and the other aspects of the tough farm environment.

premises.text: The gripper can handle varying sizes and shapes of produce without needing adjustments
premises.evidence_span: This lets the same gripper grab produce across a large range of size and shape without needing any information from software or any hardware changes.

premises.text: Traptic's robots can find berries and determine ripeness with accuracy comparable to humans
premises.evidence_span: Traptix robot can find berries and determine ripeness with equivalent accuracy as people.

premises.text: Traptic's service model charges growers per pound of strawberries picked
premises.evidence_span: We pick strawberries, and growers will pay us 23 cents per pound.

premises.text: Traptic does not require changes in the growing process for deployment
premises.evidence_span: we don't require any change in growing process, providing a smooth path for deployment.

value.text: Traptic aims to save the world's food production system through automation
value.evidence_span: help save the world's food production system.

notes: Partnerships and team background excluded as traction.
